title: Write 3 long-form LinkedIn thought-leadership posts on the hidden costs of per-student pricing for African bootcamps
description:
Write 3 engaging, high-authority LinkedIn posts (200-300 words each) tailored for bootcamp founders, edtech CEOs, and academic directors in Nigeria and West Africa.

Topics:
1. Post 1: 'The Per-Student Penalty: How foreign LMS tools punish growing African bootcamps with rising monthly bills'.
2. Post 2: 'Tool Sprawl vs All-in-One: The hidden cost of duct-taping Zoom, WhatsApp, Drive, and Slack'.
3. Post 3: 'Empowering Instructors, Not Replacing Them: Why assistive AI is the true future of African cohort education'.

Each post must include an attention-grabbing hook, realistic numbers contrasting flat ₦20K/month pricing against per-student pricing, and a non-pushy call to action to explore Zedu Starter. Deliver complete markdown in the attachment.
rationale: Builds organic authority and drives inbound bootcamp coordinator leads by addressing their core frustration with expensive per-seat software.
